# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]

    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

big impact with a personal touch.

and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### [ Usage of Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) ][49]

Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) is a versatile compound with a wide range of applications
across various industries. Here are some common uses:

1. **Food Industry:**
   - **Thickener and Stabilizer:** CMC is widely used as a thickening agent and stabilizer in the
food industry. It can improve the texture, viscosity, and mouthfeel of a wide range of food
products, including sauces, dressings, dairy products, and baked goods.
   - **Emulsifier:** CMC can also act as an emulsifier, helping to stabilize oil-in-water emulsions
in products like salad dressings and ice cream.
   - **Binder:** In food processing, CMC can serve as a binder to improve the cohesion and texture
of meat products, such as sausages and burgers.

2. **Pharmaceuticals:**
   - **Tablet Binder:** CMC is commonly used as a binder in pharmaceutical tablet formulations. It
helps hold the ingredients together and ensures uniformity in the tablet's structure.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise.

partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты

создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

## Third party manufacturing FAQs

What is third party manufacturing in pharma?
Third party manufacturing — also called contract or loan-licence manufacturing — is when a pharma
brand gets its products made by a separate WHO-GMP certified facility, under the brand's own name
and packaging. It lets you sell a full range without owning a plant.
How do I get matched with a verified manufacturer?
Post your requirement free with the product, dosage form and quantity. Our team matches you with
verified manufacturers and shares quotes — usually within 24 hours. There's no listing fee for
buyers.
Are the manufacturers actually certified?
Yes. Listed manufacturers are verified for WHO-GMP, ISO and applicable DCGI / state drug-licence
compliance before they appear in match results, so you're not vetting credentials from scratch.
What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
MOQ varies by dosage form and manufacturer. Tablets and capsules usually start lower than injections
or specialised derma ranges. Share your quantity in the requirement form and matched manufacturers
quote their MOQ directly.
Do you cover ayurvedic and nutraceutical products too?
Absolutely. Beyond allopathic pharma, the network covers ayurvedic & herbal ranges, nutraceuticals,
protein powders, probiotic sachets and cosmetic/derma products — all from certified facilities.

## Third party manufacturing FAQs

What is third party manufacturing in pharma?
Third party manufacturing — also called contract or loan-licence manufacturing — is when a pharma
brand gets its products made by a separate WHO-GMP certified facility, under the brand's own name
and packaging. It lets you sell a full range without owning a plant.
How do I get matched with a verified manufacturer?
Post your requirement free with the product, dosage form and quantity. Our team matches you with
verified manufacturers and shares quotes — usually within 24 hours. There's no listing fee for
buyers.
Are the manufacturers actually certified?
Yes. Listed manufacturers are verified for WHO-GMP, ISO and applicable DCGI / state drug-licence
compliance before they appear in match results, so you're not vetting credentials from scratch.
What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
MOQ varies by dosage form and manufacturer. Tablets and capsules usually start lower than injections
or specialised derma ranges. Share your quantity in the requirement form and matched manufacturers
quote their MOQ directly.
Do you cover ayurvedic and nutraceutical products too?
Absolutely. Beyond allopathic pharma, the network covers ayurvedic & herbal ranges, nutraceuticals,
protein powders, probiotic sachets and cosmetic/derma products — all from certified facilities.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

manufacturing processes are designed in accordance with **current Good Manufacturing Practices

quality control laboratories are strategically located in **Rajkot, Gujarat**, one of India's
prominent industrial hubs. Managed by a team of experienced professionals with extensive expertise
in pharmaceutical manufacturing, SNJ Labs Pvt. Ltd. is committed to providing innovative solutions,

### SUCRALFATE

SUCRALFATE (SOO kral fate) treats stomach ulcers. It works by helping to form a barrier over the
ulcer, which protects it from stomach acid and allows it to heal. This medicine may be used for
other purposes; ask your health care provider or pharmacist if you have questions.

**Formula :** C12H54Al16O75S8

**CAS No. :** 54182-58-0

**IUPAC Name : **Aluminium hydroxide 1,3,4,6-tetra-O-sulfonato-β-D-, fructofuranosyl
2,3,4,6-tetra-O-sulfonato-α-D-, glucopyranoside (8:16:1)

**Synonyms :** Sucralfato, Sucralfatum, Sucrose octakis(hydrogen sulfate) aluminum complex,
Hexadeca-mu-hydroxytetracosahydroxy(mu8-(1,3,4,6-tetra-O-sulfo-beta-Dfructofuranosyl-alpha-D-glucopy
ranoside, tetrakis(hydrogen sulfato)8-)))hexadecaaluminum.

**Application :** Anticonvulsant (or anti-epileptic)

**Grade : **IP/ JP/ USP

**GMP :** GMP is available

**DMF :** Open and close part DMF is available

Structure of Sucralfate

Sucralfate has been approved for use in patients with iron deficiency who have had inadequate
response to oral therapy, intolerance to oral iron, nondialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease, or
inflammatory bowel disease.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

* Cardio-Metabolic
